entities.summary: Islamic Republic, a political institution in Iran during Islamic Revolution and Iran-Iraq War (1979–1980). Grew from Iranian students seize the US Embassy — 444-day hostage crisis begins and Shah flees Iran; Ayatollah Khomeini returns from exile. Led to the emergence of 1979 Islamic Revolution and Iraq invades Iran, beginning the longest conventional war of the 20th century.
